in_sanskrit.name: Bahumanya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of great courage
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bahumanya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bahumanya is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'bahu' meaning 'great' and 'manya' meaning 'courage'. This name is given to a child who is believed to be blessed with immense courage and strength, worthy of a lord.
